composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# A repeated create carrying an already-seen Idempotency-Key replays the originally
# created owner (200) rather than creating a duplicate. First seen (or no key): proceed
# to build. This runs first so the replay short-circuits before the duplicate check. It
# only reads an in-memory token store and branches, so it needs no transaction.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  outputs:
    proceed: build
    replay: replayLoad

# Replay branch: load and respond with the remembered owner (200), mirroring GET. A read,
# so readonly-transaction; reuses the shared RespondWithOwner responder.
replayLoad:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadReplayedOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: replayRespond
replayRespond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

# Validate the postcode (when present) against the city's region before any
# persistence work, so an out-of-range postcode is a 400.
validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectDuplicateIdentity

# Hard duplicate detection (409): rejects an owner whose identityKey (SHA-256 over normalized
# telephone, lower-cased email and soundex(lastName)) matches an existing, non-deleted owner's.
# Runs after the email-domain blocklist and telephone normalization so the key is comparable.
rejectDuplicateIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDuplicateIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeAddress

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectFutureRegistrationDate

# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server date (400), before the
# weekend-roll normalization so the check is on the supplied date.
rejectFutureRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectFutureRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeRegistrationDate

normalizeRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

# Store the deterministic householdId (hash of last name + postcode) on the owner, for
# OwnerIdentity and the DTO. The duplicate check and household-size count below derive the
# household themselves, so they do not read this stored value.
assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectCityAtCapacity

rejectCityAtCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectCityAtCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagCityCapacityWarning

# Soft capacity signal: sets capacityWarning when the city already holds 40-49 owners
# (approaching the hard limit of 50). Runs after the hard reject above, so the count is
# at most 49 here; flags, never rejects.
flagCityCapacityWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagCityCapacityWarning
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectOverDailyLimit

rejectOverDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectOverDailyLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countHouseholdMembers

countHouseholdMembers:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountHouseholdMembers
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: countNamesakes

countNamesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountOwnerNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagBulkSignup

flagBulkSignup:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagBulkSignup
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipLevel

assignMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# Cap the derived level to at most one above the current maximum membershipLevel among
# the owner's existing household members. No existing household member => no cap.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: flagPossibleDuplicate

# Soft duplicate signal: shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different
# telephone. Flags, never rejects; skipped for a declared household member (sharesHousehold).
flagPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Remember this owner under the request's Idempotency-Key (when present) so a repeat
# create replays it. After save so the owner has its id; no-op when no key was supplied.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner. When present it is one of
            MR, MRS, MS or DR. It is stored and returned, and the owner's
            salutation is composed from it with the last name.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            First line of the owner's structured postal address (street number and
            name). Preferred over the flat 'address' field when present; when present
            it must be non-blank. Normalized on create (trimmed, whitespace collapsed,
            upper-cased, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.).
            Normalized on create the same way as addressLine1 and, when present,
            appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 5'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for backward
            compatibility when the structured 'addressLine1' is not supplied. On create
            it is the composed, normalized address: equal to the normalized addressLine1
            with the normalized addressLine2 appended after a single space when present,
            or the normalized flat value when only the flat form was supplied. An owner
            must supply an address in either form (a non-blank addressLine1, or this
            flat field) plus a city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be a 4-digit value and,
            for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's inclusive
            range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. It is
            stored and returned.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits;
            there must be 8 to 15 digits after the '+'. The E.164 value is stored
            and returned (e.g. '0412 345 678' becomes '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. It is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time flag. The householdId is always deterministic from (last name,
            postcode), so this flag no longer creates the link. It only bypasses the
            duplicate block: a second owner in an existing household is rejected with 409
            unless it sets sharesHousehold true, in which case it is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. When
            present it is stored and returned, and the owner's ageBand is derived from
            it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation composed from the optional title and the
                last name: '<title> <lastName>' when a title is present, or just
                the last name when no title was supplied. Derived from the
                owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The owner's initials as the upper-cased first letters of
                firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code (with its leading '+'), a space, then the national digits
                grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678' becomes
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived from the owner's own telephone; the
                raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION
                is the region code derived from the postcode and HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized telephone
                concatenated with the lastName. Assigned on create.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the two-digit fiscal year of the (business-day-adjusted)
                registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June
                2026 yields '26' (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'). Derived from the owner's
                own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's (business-day-adjusted) registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the
                calendar year in which it ends, so a date from 1 July 2025 to 30 June
                2026 yields 'FY26'. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A deterministic identifier shared by owners of the same household:
                the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last name
                and postcode. Assigned to every owner on create, so owners with the
                same last name and postcode return the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: '3f9a2c1b8d4e'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email-or-empty>|<householdId-or-empty>'
                where the telephone is the stored E.164 value, the email is the
                stored lower-cased address (empty when absent) and the household
                id is the stored value (empty when absent). A derived field returned
                on the owner; duplicate detection itself is keyed on the household
                (last name and postcode). Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) that
                shared the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed on creation. Starts at 0, adds 2
                when an email address is present, adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0, adds 2
                for a household of three or more members and adds 3 for tenure over one
                elapsed fiscal year. Derived from the owner's own fields.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, fixed on creation and derived from
                membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3 points, 3 for 4-5
                points and 4 for 6 or more points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner, though not a hard (identityKey) duplicate, was
                created while sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a
                different telephone; false otherwise. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (shared
                lastName and postcode, different telephone); the lowest-id match when
                several exist. Present only when possibleDuplicate is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, so the owner is still returned by GET but is ignored by the
                create endpoint's duplicate/identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality (region) taken from the REGION segment of the
                customerCode identity ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived
                from the postcode (city-to-region table as fallback: Sydney->NSW,
                Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when no region resolves.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via
                the pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney,
                VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region has no mapped timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's (business-day-adjusted) registration date at the time this
                owner was created, otherwise false. Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when the owner's city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, signalling the city
                is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
                Assigned on create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the owner's
                own fields: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise
                'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birthDate against the
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64,
                'SENIOR' at 65 or over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM'
                when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',
                'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
                Derived from the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

              type: array

              readOnly: true
